engineExpertQuestions.label: Expo workflow — Managed (default) or Bare
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Managed workflow means Expo controls the native build; Bare gives full native project access but requires maintaining ios/ and android/ yourself.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Navigation — Expo Router (file-based, default) or React Navigation
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Expo Router aligns with web routing conventions and deep linking works out of the box. React Navigation offers more flexibility but requires manual deep-link configuration.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Target platforms — iOS only, Android only, or both
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Both platforms are supported, but some community libraries behave differently on each. Knowing the target up front avoids late-breaking platform-specific rewrites.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Authentication — none, OAuth/social login, email+password, biometric
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Determines which Expo Auth Session / SecureStore patterns and native permission prompts to configure.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Offline support — none, read-only cache, full offline-first
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Full offline-first requires a local database (WatermelonDB or SQLite via expo-sqlite) and a sync strategy on reconnect.
